srList.sentence: Genome-wide genotyping of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) was performed for the 1,531 unrelated individuals on three genotyping platforms: for 678 participants, genotyping was performed using Affymetrix GeneChip (Affymetrix Inc., Santa Clara, CA), for 634 participants, genotyping was performed using Infinium OmniExpress BeadChip (Illumina Inc., San Diego, CA), and 219 participants were genotyped using Infinium PsychArray BeadChip (Illumina Inc.).
